messages:
elaine: Heads-up: we're scheduling a pen-test dry run for next week. Need to finalize RBAC, KMS proxy behavior, and evidence ingestion hooks. Can someone own the assessor onboarding checklist?

priya: I can own onboarding. Quick questions: do assessors get cross-account S3 access or do they upload into our bucket? Also what's the expected KMS flow (decrypt in-proxy vs give GenerateDataKey only)?

tom: Prefer upload-to-our-bucket model. We’ll hand out a timeboxed role `pt_assessor_upload` with minimal s3:GetObject/PutObject for a single prefix. KMS: we will not export plaintext to assessors. KMS-proxy will perform envelope decrypts and return only artifacts metadata.

elaine: Good. Priya, make sure we include checksum verification and a manifest file for each upload. Use `sha256sum` and a small metadata.json with fields: submitter, assay-id, checksum, tool-version.

priya: Will do. Draft of role policy (short):
```
- Allow: s3:PutObject s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt/*/uploads/*
- Deny: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt/*/secrets/*
- Allow: sts:AssumeRole with externalId = pt-dryrun-2026
```

dave: Audit requirements: enable a dedicated CloudTrail trail `pt-dryrun-trail` sending to pt-logs-bucket. Add object-level logging on the bucket and enable Data Access events. Audit-bot will snapshot and store to /archive/pt-dryrun/ with 90d retention.

ops-bot: Reminder: presigned put URLs should expire <= 48h for the dry run. Command example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt/team-x/uploads/evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 172800` :lock:

elaine: On KMS proxy, requirements: 1) must log caller, request-id, key-id; 2) only allow Wrap/Unwrap and GenerateDataKey; 3) block any kms:Decrypt actions from assessor principal. Tom/Dave, can you validate proxy logs are forwarded to the pt-trail?

tom: Yup, proxy will emit structured JSON to stdout and we forward to the logs collector. I'll attach an example log snippet to the onboarding doc.

priya: Ops questions: how do assessors get temporary creds? We need a clear TTL and rotation time. My suggestion: create creds with 4h TTL and allow refresh once during the window with manual approval.

elaine: Agreed. Also add a kill-switch checklist: 1) revoke role trust 2) disable presigned uploads 3) rotate the pt prefix policy. Keep an incident channel `#pt-run-ops` open during the window.

dave: Proposed retest slots: Mon 10:00-12:00 UTC and Wed 16:00-18:00 UTC. Owners for both: @tom (proxy), @priya (evidence), @elaine (incident).

priya: I'll publish the onboarding doc and include sample presign script, checksum validator, and the JIRA template for triage issues. Link will be in this thread when ready.

audit-bot: Snapshot job scheduled: cloudtrail export at 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z. Manifest will be posted to s3://pt-logs-bucket/archive/manifest-1765432109.json

elaine: Thanks all. Priya please ping once onboarding doc is live and Tom confirm proxy healthcheck. We want to run a mini dry-run (internal only) 24h prior to the external assesment. :white_check_mark:
